_doc: S0 example: the music reward arm on one GPU tray, one vLLM server, local (unsandboxed) bash+submit tools. JSON has no comments, so every section below carries its own '_doc' string, which the loader strips before validating keys -- never read as a declared field. Validate this file with: foundationscale-agentic-rl --config examples/agentic_rl/music_s0.json --dry-run

policy._doc: model_path is the HF id/local path the real run loads (tokenizer + policy weights). algorithm is a foundationscale.rl registry name; 'agentic_grpo' is the group-relative objective this plane wires end to end.

trainer._doc: Keys here map EXACTLY onto rl.trainer.RLTrainConfig field names (dynamically read, never hand-duplicated) -- model/algorithm/rollout_source are refused here, declared under 'policy' or built internally instead. 'dataset' is ALSO refused here: RLTrainConfig.dataset defaults to None now, and RLTrainer.run() refuses dataset-together-with-rollout_source by name (the rollout source replaces the corpus draw entirely, so a declared dataset would never be read) and skips the gold-letter-corpus refusal whenever rollout_source is set. temperature/top_p/top_k/max_new_tokens/group_size here are ALSO vestigial under rollout_source EXCEPT for one early greedy-decoding guard (group_size>1 and temperature<=0 refuses before any step) -- leave them at their defaults unless you mean to touch that guard; the sampling that actually reaches the engine is the top-level 'sampling' section below.

engine._doc: kind='vllm' because the GB200 estate ships vLLM, not SGLang (see docs/AGENTIC_RL.md). command is the FULL argv (declared, never assembled from pieces) launched exactly as given. served_model_name must equal vLLM's --served-model-name (or --model when that flag is omitted) -- every /v1/completions request carries it as 'model'. weight_sync_mode='reload_endpoint' asks each publish() to reload over /collective_rpc, which requires reload_mode='collective_rpc' declared here too (PROBED on the real cluster: POST /collective_rpc {method:'reload_weights', kwargs:{weights_path:<dir>}} -- 'model_path' is rejected with a 500; see engines/vllm.py's UNPROBED ASSUMPTIONS for what is still unverified beyond that) -- config-time refused by name if kind='vllm'+weight_sync_mode='reload_endpoint' with reload_mode left null. 'restart' (stop+relaunch with a declared '{model_path}' placeholder substituted into command) is the alternative S0 path needing no reload_mode at all. env is the engine subprocess's COMPLETE environment, an explicit allow-list never merged with this process's own os.environ -- a real vLLM launch needs at least PATH/HOME to run python at all, CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES to pick its GPU tray, VLLM_SERVER_DEV_MODE=1 to expose /collective_rpc, and PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1 so a user site-packages install can never shadow the cluster's pinned vLLM.

env._doc: backend='local' runs model-chosen bash commands directly on this host in a fresh temp dir; it has no isolation, so allow_unsandboxed=true is the explicit opt-in EnvSpec/check_isolation require (never a silent default).

harness._doc: native_tool_loop is the only harness this plane builds. parser picks the tool-call wire format the policy was trained/templated to emit: 'qwen_xml' (Qwen-style <tool_call> XML) or 'hermes_json' (a JSON object inside the call tags). tools='default' is the built-in bash+submit registry (tools.default_tools()).
harness.name: native_tool_loop

budget._doc: Hard per-episode ceilings (harness.base.EpisodeBudget). step_limit bounds tool-call turns; max_response_tokens/max_observation_chars bound what the model emits and what a tool result may show it back.

sampling._doc: harness.base.SamplingParams for every /v1/completions call the engine makes. top_k=0 means 'no restriction' (engines.vllm translates it to vLLM's own -1 sentinel).

rollout._doc: tasks_path is the JSONL pool (see tasks.py); each step draws tasks_per_step tasks and runs group_size attempts of each concurrently (bounded by max_concurrency). seed makes TaskSource.batch(step, n) deterministic across resumes.

reward._doc: kind='music' is the only reward this plane builds today (rewards/music/: rule-scored MIDI human-likeness over the submitted ABC notation). abc2midi_bin is never read from the environment -- name the binary explicitly, 'abc2midi' if it is on PATH.
